fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Passports must be valid for at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses desde la llegada y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: Visitors must hold a ticket for return or onward travel and enough funds for their stay.
entry.es: Los visitantes deben tener un billete de vuelta o de continuación y fondos suficientes para su estancia.
entry.quote: You must hold a ticket for return or onward travel and enough funds for your stay.

entry.en: A departure tax of 20 Australian dollars must be paid at the airport.
entry.es: Hay que pagar en el aeropuerto una tasa de salida de 20 dólares australianos.
entry.quote: You must pay a 20 Australian dollar departure tax at the airport.

entry.en: There is a strict quarantine regime for importing food, plant and animal products, including fish, to Kiribati.
entry.es: Hay un estricto régimen de cuarentena para importar a Kiribati productos alimentarios, vegetales y animales, incluido el pescado.
entry.quote: There is a strict quarantine regime for importing food, plant and animal (including fish) products to Kiribati.

safety.en: Although there is no recent history of terrorism in Kiribati, attacks cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: Aunque no hay historial reciente de terrorismo en Kiribati, no se pueden descartar ataques.
safety.quote: Although there’s no recent history of terrorism in Kiribati, attacks cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Kiribati, with a penalty of up to 14 years imprisonment if found guilty.
safety.es: Los actos sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Kiribati, con una pena de hasta 14 años de prisión.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual acts are illegal. If found guilty, the penalty could be up to 14 years imprisonment.

safety.en: Visitors should not swim in the lagoon in south Tarawa, as it is highly polluted.
safety.es: No se debe nadar en la laguna del sur de Tarawa, porque está muy contaminada.
safety.quote: Do not swim in the lagoon in south Tarawa, as it is highly polluted.

safety.en: There are very strong rip tides along the coast and reef areas.
safety.es: Hay corrientes de resaca muy fuertes en las zonas costeras y de arrecife.
safety.quote: There are very strong rip tides along coast and reef areas.

safety.en: Stray dogs have bitten visitors, so be cautious, particularly on the beach.
safety.es: Los perros callejeros han mordido a visitantes, así que hay que tener cuidado, sobre todo en la playa.
safety.quote: Stray dogs have bitten visitors. Be cautious, particularly on the beach.

safety.en: It may be risky to be outside after dark in Betio or along the beach in South Tarawa, especially for single females.
safety.es: Puede ser arriesgado salir de noche en Betio o por la playa del sur de Tarawa, especialmente para mujeres solas.
safety.quote: it may be risky to be outside after dark in Betio or along the beach in South Tarawa, especially for single females.

health.en: Visitors should drink and use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.
health.es: Se debe beber y usar solo agua hervida o embotellada y evitar el hielo en las bebidas.
health.quote: Drink and use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.

health.en: Visitors should not eat local shellfish or lagoon fish on Tarawa.
health.es: No se debe comer marisco local ni pescado de la laguna en Tarawa.
health.quote: Do not eat local shellfish or lagoon fish on Tarawa.

health.en: Medicines are generally not available, so bring any you need.
health.es: Los medicamentos generalmente no están disponibles, así que hay que llevar los necesarios.
health.quote: Pharmaceuticals – both prescription and non-prescription medicines – are generally not available. Bring any medicines you need with you.

health.en: Non-basic medical treatment will usually require medical evacuation from Kiribati.
health.es: Para un tratamiento médico no básico normalmente se necesitará una evacuación médica desde Kiribati.
health.quote: If you need any non-basic medical treatment, you will usually need medical evacuation from Kiribati.

health.en: There is no malaria, but dengue fever outbreaks sometimes occur.
health.es: No hay malaria, pero a veces se producen brotes de dengue.
health.quote: There's no malaria, but dengue fever outbreaks (mosquito transmitted) do sometimes occur.

health.en: Wikivoyage recommends a hepatitis A vaccination and being up to date on all other vaccinations.
health.es: Wikivoyage recomienda la vacuna de la hepatitis A y tener al día el resto de vacunas.
health.quote: Get a hepatitis A vaccination, and be up-to-date on all your other vaccinations

help.en: The emergency number is 999 for ambulance, fire and police, with local numbers 994, 993 and 992 respectively.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 999 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía, con los locales 994, 993 y 992 respectivamente.
help.quote:
Telephone 999 (ambulance, fire, police) or local numbers:

Ambulance: 994

Fire: 993

Police: 992

help.en: FCDO can be called in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas, si ha ocurrido algo a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

getting_in.en: Fiji Airways flies to Tarawa and Kiritimati, with non-stop flights to Tarawa twice weekly from Nadi.
getting_in.es: Fiji Airways vuela a Tarawa y Kiritimati, con vuelos directos a Tarawa dos veces por semana desde Nadi.
getting_in.quote: Flights to Tarawa are twice weekly non-stop flights (3 hrs) from Nadi (Fiji)

getting_in.en: Nauru Airlines connects Tarawa with Nauru, Honiara and Nadi.
getting_in.es: Nauru Airlines conecta Tarawa con Nauru, Honiara y Nadi.
getting_in.quote: Nauru Airlines (formerly Air Nauru) connect Tarawa in Kiribati with Nauru, Honiara and Nadi.

getting_in.en: Kiritimati is a stop on a weekly flight each way between Nadi and Honolulu.
getting_in.es: Kiritimati es una escala de un vuelo semanal en cada sentido entre Nadi y Honolulú.
getting_in.quote: Kiritimati is a stop on a weekly flight each way between Nadi and Honolulu.

getting_around.en: Air Kiribati has two turboprop aircraft for inter-island travel, with regular flights to all Outer Islands in the Gilbert group.
getting_around.es: Air Kiribati tiene dos aviones turbohélice para viajes entre islas, con vuelos regulares a todas las islas exteriores del grupo Gilbert.
getting_around.quote: Air Kiribati has two turboprop aircraft for inter-island travel. Flights travel to all Outer Islands in the Gilbert group regularly.

getting_around.en: It is important to reconfirm your return flight on arrival at your destination.
getting_around.es: Es importante reconfirmar el vuelo de regreso al llegar al destino.
getting_around.quote: It is important to reconfirm your return flight on arrival at your destination.

getting_around.en: For ship connections within the Gilbert Islands, ask at the harbour in Betio, South Tarawa.
getting_around.es: Para conexiones en barco dentro de las islas Gilbert, se puede preguntar en el puerto de Betio, en el sur de Tarawa.
getting_around.quote: For ship connections within the Gilbert Islands you might ask at the harbour in Betio, South Tarawa.

getting_around.en: Road conditions are poor on Tarawa, and minibuses can be dangerously overloaded.
getting_around.es: El estado de las carreteras de Tarawa es malo y los minibuses pueden ir peligrosamente sobrecargados.
getting_around.quote: Road conditions are poor on Tarawa, but driving standards are reasonable. Minibuses can be dangerously overloaded.

money.en: Australian dollars are the official currency, and Kiribati issues its own coins pegged 1:1 to the Australian dollar.
money.es: El dólar australiano es la moneda oficial, y Kiribati emite sus propias monedas con paridad 1:1 con el dólar australiano.
money.quote: Kiribati issues its own coins in denominations of 5¢, 10¢, 20¢, 50¢, $1 and $2, but it is pegged at a 1:1 rate to the Australian dollar.

money.en: Very few places accept credit cards in Kiribati.
money.es: Muy pocos lugares aceptan tarjetas de crédito en Kiribati.
money.quote: Very few places accept credit cards in Kiribati.

money.en: There are ATMs at branches of the Bank of Kiribati and ANZ in Betio, Bairiki and Bikenibeu on Tarawa atoll.
money.es: Hay cajeros en sucursales del Bank of Kiribati y ANZ en Betio, Bairiki y Bikenibeu, en el atolón de Tarawa.
money.quote: There are ATMs at branches of the Bank of Kiribati and ANZ in Betio, Bairiki and Bikenibeu on Tarawa atoll.

money.en: Cash only is used on the Outer Islands and banking services are not available there.
money.es: En las islas exteriores solo se usa efectivo y no hay servicios bancarios.
money.quote: Cash only is used on the Outer Islands and banking services are not available.

etiquette.en: Visitors should respect local customs about dress, including swimming costumes, and local laws ban public nudity and revealing swimming costumes.
etiquette.es: Se deben respetar las costumbres locales de vestimenta, incluidos los bañadores, y la ley prohíbe el desnudo público y los bañadores reveladores.
etiquette.quote: You should respect local customs about dress, including swimming costumes. Local laws ban public nudity and revealing swimming costumes.

etiquette.en: Before swimming, it might be a good idea to ask the landowner, as there may be stone figures of religious importance with rules to follow.
etiquette.es: Antes de bañarse, puede ser buena idea preguntar al propietario del terreno, pues puede haber figuras de piedra de importancia religiosa con normas que seguir.
etiquette.quote: Before going to swim it might be a good idea to ask the landowner. There might be stone figures of religious importance around which certain rules should be followed.

connectivity.en: Internet and mobile phone services are available in some parts of Kiribati, but not all outer islands are connected.
connectivity.es: Hay servicios de internet y telefonía móvil en algunas partes de Kiribati, pero no todas las islas exteriores están conectadas.
connectivity.quote: Internet and mobile phone services are available in some parts of Kiribati. Not all of the outer islands are connected.

connectivity.en: Vodafone has a 3G 900 network covering most inhabited islands, with 4G support at some of them.
connectivity.es: Vodafone tiene una red 3G 900 que cubre la mayoría de las islas habitadas, con 4G en algunas.
connectivity.quote: Vodafone has a subsidiary on Kiribati with a 3G 900 network covering most inhabited islands, also with 4G  support at some of them.

connectivity.en: A tourist eSIM costs around USD 50 for 1GB valid for a month, while a physical SIM from the Vodafone office in Bairiki is reportedly much cheaper.
connectivity.es: Una eSIM para turistas cuesta unos 50 USD por 1 GB al mes, mientras que una SIM física de la oficina de Vodafone en Bairiki es, según se informa, mucho más barata.
connectivity.quote: Direct access through eSIM for tourists is expensive at around USD $50 for 1GB eSIM valid for a month
